notes.content:

Hello everyone, 

In case you missed it, Etherborn launched last week! Have you played it already? With the launch now behind us, we can take a bit of a breather and see what the reaction was (launch day is a crazy event - sooo many things going around. It was terrific and terrifying at the same time). One of the things we couldn’t stop doing was looking for and reading impressions and reviews of Etherborn. [i]“It’s a carefully directed, genuinely beautiful game well worth your time.”[/i]
- [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2019/07/18/etherborn-review/]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

notes.title: Gravity-defying puzzle platformer Etherborn is out today
notes.content:
Etherborn is a puzzle platformer with a focus on gravity-defying traversal, and while it might not be the first game based on that premise, it's probably among the best looking. The nameless, voiceless protagonist inhabits a surreal world of floating structures, and is tempted through them by a bodiless voice. Once reached, this bodiless voice will apparently help the protagonist "understand [their] own existence". (Why not just send an email ffs?)

As the trailer below demonstrates, the diabolically warped illustrations of M.C. Escher are a clear inspiration. According to the Steam description, the player experiences "gravity perpendicular to the surface you are standing on, allowing for creative exploration possibilities in environments carefully crafted as navigation-based puzzles".

It's definitely gorgeous to look at, and it's available on Steam now. Check out the launch trailer below, or check out some .gifs Austin showcased back in 2017.

notes.title: An update on our release date
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/4d2aca2de52a6897b0430da906da3432424892ce.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

First up, we have to admit that we’ve been a bit quiet lately on our end when it comes to announcing our release date. For that, we want to say thank you for being patient, and apologies for not saying anything sooner.

[b]We won’t be making the Spring date as we mentioned in our latest announcement.[/b] We’ve been hard at work and have actually completed the game, and we are now dealing with the submission to the console platforms.

However, we’ve decided to hold on the release for just a bit longer. The end of May to the end of June period is a complicated time to release a game. The reason being - having E3 and the Steam Summer Sale happening one after the other.

Since we are a small title, it would be harder to get journalists to cover and review our game, and for people to pay notice to us with one of the biggest gaming shows taking place at the same time (damn you Call of Duty). And with Steam Summer Sale offering crazy deals to gamers, having our game at full price compete with some heavily discounted titles could put us in a bit of a disadvantaged spot as well (damn you GTA V and Witcher 3).

So for these reasons, we will postpone our release - but by not much longer. And as a matter of fact, [b]we will announce our definitive release date really soon[/b] (*cough* *cough* #KFGE3Showcase).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/479c5179f427c1b48c0206e332dc0428bc607645.jpg[/img]

We hope you understand our position. We want to have the best possible launch, and these extra weeks will also serve to have more time to prepare everything without rushing. It seems that this is the best chance in making sure that these years of work pay off in the end. We hope you understand that.

And as always, if you have any questions, ask us away on [url=https://www.facebook.com/EtherbornGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Etherborn]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/etherborn_game/]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/dfDx4nn]Discord[/url].


Until next time (when we announce the release date :) )

Michal | Altered Matter Team

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7Uc8d0Qxrs

The other big news is that we’ve partnered up with FoxNext Games - we are the debut title of their Indie Spotlight program! Thanks to their support, we’ve been able to make Etherborn even better.

Ok, as I am writing this, our announcement and trailer has just gone live. Everyone on our team is buzzing with excitement. There’s also a smidge of nerves in the air too. Will people like our trailer? What will people think of the game? I hope they liked what we are working on. Will they even care? These are just some of the questions that are going through our heads. notes.title: 20th Century Fox debut indie development fund with Etherborn
notes.content:
Gravity-bending puzzle platformer Etherborn is to be the first independent game funded by FoxNext Games, the games division of the least indie media conglomerates on earth: 20th Century Fox. Altered Matter’s puzzler seems like a safe first pick – it’s a very fetching-looking game full of colourful, floating geometry and paths to walk that bend gravity as you follow them. The texture-light aesthetic, ethereal soundtrack and introspective story revolving around ‘finding your voice’ don’t seem very daring, but it’s still lovely to look at. Take a peek at the game in motion below.

notes.title: BIC Fest 2018 Award Finalists and Game Localisation
notes.content:
Hello there!

We’re doing this a bit late, but we wanted to share the news anyway! A few weeks ago Etherborn was part of the BIC Fest 2018 in Busan - South Korea, and we're very proud and happy to say that we were a finalist in no less than 4 different awards!

[u]Etherborn was nominated in these categories:[/u]
Grand Prix
Excellence In Art
Excellence In Experimental
Excellence In Game Design

Other great games such as Wattam and Bossgard took away the prizes, but we're very glad to have been considered for these! It's a big honor for us to share these shows with all these amazing games, and for our ideas to get this kind of recognition. :)

You can read about the awards and check the other games in the [url=http://www.bicfest.org/en/?c=123] BIC Fest website[/url].

And some images of our game in the show.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/bae6845a6885181b01298f1c54b7033c4e8231dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
On a kind of related note, since the festival was held in South Korea, we wanted to have a more localised version available there. So we managed to prepare a demo with South Korean text and subtitles on time.

In the last weeks, we’ve been working on the localisation to other languages as well, and we're very happy to say that the game is already (almost) translated to English, Spanish, Catalan, German, French, Italian, Russian, South Korean, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

As a reminder, the game also features full audio in English, Spanish, and Catalan.

A few work-in-progress captures:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/c9e693093a7d0772d80b301b92098acb6e03432b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/9a6346c53b10227e77854b72d702842983779288.jpg[/img]

This is all for the moment! We'll keep sharing more news, so follow us on [url=twitter.com/Etherborn]Twitter [/url] or like us on [url=facebook.com/EtherbornGame] Facebook [/url] for all your day to day updates or join our own Discord server with Fig-only channels as well. And be sure to wishlist the game on the Etherborn Steam page.


Until next time, 

- ALTERED MATTER

notes.title: Etherborn at gamescom and a snippet of English voice-overs
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

[b]Last week we had the pleasure of being part of gamescom 2018.[/b] And the best part was that we had two separate booths - one as part of the official Indie Arena Booth line-up and part of the ICEX Games from Spain booth. We had hundreds of people play our game on the show floor, along with the press, influencers, and other devs as well. Getting live feedback and comments was really useful, and seeing our fans in real life was an absolute blast - thank you!

Below are some photos from the show floor: 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/d1762773863f2269f3f24312359527b7c228a6bf.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/690c7f45f1e770499f9a7b6c4f82b8407c721847.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/84ee9e4d71ea12ce35b26c2a7be3166e36dbb12c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/3c2e44706c52bddcf1a21dd7e00b373f7bc7cf3d.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/c2fc6e036e2fa1802bc893e1f50fd82c44835e7f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/cb3f7b9e524cd21b317a965f5c8c106339a742f0.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/28d84ab174fae91b01bf4e200d91beaafe333630.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/ef5818f43df586661f398be13ac64516e14e8151.jpg[/img][/url]

Next up on our itinerary - South Korea, and the Busan Indie Games Festival in September. It blows our minds that people on the other side of the world will get to play our game - fingers crossed they will like it.


This week, we also have a little treat. [b] We received the English voice recordings from Natalie Winter - our voice artist that will appear in Etherborn.[/b] Hearing her saying those lines makes us feel that the project is becoming alive as days go on. It really is exhilarating and frightening at the same time - it’s a buzz that’s really hard to describe. Below is a little sample from what you’ll see and hear in the game - let us know what you think!

🎧 [url=https://soundcloud.com/alteredmatter/etherborn-english-voice-sample] Hop over to our Soundcloud page[/url] 


Anyway, that’s it from us for today. We will be making some new announcements really soon, so please stay tuned. And as always, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Etherborn] Twitter[/url] or like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/EtherbornGame] Facebook[/url] for all your day to day updates. Plus, we have our own [url=https://discord.gg/dfDx4nn] Discord server [/url] as well. 

And be sure to wishlist the game so that you don't miss our launch on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/812160/Etherborn] Etherborn Steam page[/url].


Until next time, 

Michal | Altered Matter Team

notes.title: Etherborn is coming to gamescom and Busan Indie Connect Festival
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32447826/b6cfcaf8231f7a6414386cb91950787835ebd780.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

A quick update today to let you all know that we will be showcasing Etherborn at gamescom this August and at the Busan Indie Connect Festival in September. We will have playable builds available at both shows, giving you a glimpse of what Etherborn is about. 

Here are the dates for the shows:

[b]Gamescom, Cologne Germany [/b]
[i]August 21-25[/i]
You can find us in the Indie Arena Booth as well as at the Spanish Booth in the Business Area. 

[b]Busan Indie Connect, Busan, South Korea[/b]
[i]September 13-16[/i]

If you are at any of the above shows, please come by and say hello. Trust me when I say this – seeing a fan in real-life is one of the best feelings ever and it gives a sense that what we are doing is worth-while. 

So come by, play our game, say hello, and come hang with us!



Regards, 

Michal | Altered Matter Team
